persona.description: The persona slug this run simulated.

narrative.description: First-person account of the visit: where the persona went, what they did, what happened.

impression.description: How the visit felt to the persona, in a few sentences.

route.description: The path where the finding lives, e.g. /channels.

created_content.description: Titles of everything the persona created. Each must start with 'QA:'.

gave_up_on.description: What the persona wanted but could not do. Empty string if nothing.
